text:
maya: Heads-up — putting together a tiny, customer-facing "quick warm" checklist to reduce early renewal risk for low-touch accounts. Goal: <2min safe priming, non-invasive, reversible. Thoughts? :seedling:

tom.cs: Love it. Key constraints: no long-lived secrets, avoid big prefill spikes, and keep observable success metric (primed=true).

alex.sre: propose 3 steps: 1) lightweight prefix prefill (<=10 requests) 2) single-item streaming probe to validate latency and eviction behavior 3) schedule a short recheck at +30m.

maya: exactly. Draft for customer doc (short):
- step 0: confirm model + region + QPS cap with CS rep
- step 1 (cache): send 5 short canonical prompts to customer's endpoint, spread over 30s. sample curl:

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <KEY>" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-lite-1","input":"<canonical prompt>"}'
```

- step 2 (stream): open 1 streaming request to assert chunking works and SSE/WS fallback is OK
- step 3 (safety): set a TTL of 60m on any prefill cache keys or use ephemeral cache flag (`x-prefill-ttl:60m`)
- step 4 (telemetry): ensure `prefill.ping` metric shows success and `prefill.fail` alerts to CS channel

sasha.pm: add a user-facing line: "This quick warm will not change your model weights or retention — it's only to reduce cold latency." Short FAQ line.

tom.cs: operational notes for us: keep batch size small (<=4) to avoid blocking autoscaler, set `max_tokens` low for probes, and if rate-limit is hit fallback to canary endpoint. Example probe config: `{"batch_size":2,"max_tokens":32}`

maya: for renewal-risk workflow, attach `prefill_attempts` to account in CRM. If 2 attempts fail within 24h, flag for human outreach.

cs-bot: Reminder — add Prewarm run result dashboard card under account view (owners: cs-team, eng-platform). :memo:

alex.sre: One more: include a rollback snippet (how to clear prefill):
```
# delete ephemeral keys
curl -X DELETE https://internal.redwood.local/cache?account_id=ACCT123&prefill=true \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <ADMIN_KEY>"
```

maya: Nice. I'll assemble a single-page customer doc and an internal one-pager for CS + SRE triage steps. Action items: maya (doc), tom (ops knobs), alex (dashboard card).

sasha.pm: tagging @eng-oncall for visibility during first run. :eyes:

tom.cs: ack, will monitor. If we see >5% prefill errors escalate to eng-runtime.

maya: thanks team — I'll post the draft doc in #customer-success in the morning and run a dry test with sandbox tenant. :rocket:
